items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S2807

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the county law, in relation to authorizing the county
of Rockland to establish a surcharge on wireless communications


 PURPOSE OF THE BILL :
Authorizes the county of Rockland to establish a thirty cent surcharge
on wireless communication service.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section 1 of the hill amends the county law by adding a new section
308-w as it relates to the establishment of wireless surcharges for
the county of Rockland.
Paragraph 2 relates to providing written notice forty five days prior
to the imposition of the surcharge.
Paragraph 3 relates to the wireless communication service supplier
obligations.
Paragraph 4 of the bill is amended as it relates surcharge monies
shall only be expendable for costs associated with public safety
communication networks in Rockland County.

 JUSTIFICATION :
This legislation will assist Rockland County in paying for costs
associated with establishing and maintaining an enhanced emergency
telephone service system. This bill has been introduced at the request
of the Rockland County Legislature and County Executive.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New Bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
